sections.description: Connect an approved website to protected Made to Thrive plugin updates.
sections.changelog:
= 0.4.2 =
* Refresh stale update notices when a release changes, so retries use the current approved package.

= 0.4.1 =
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 0.4.0 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 0.3.0 =
* Encrypt saved website keys and support administrator-requested site approval.

= 0.2.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with bundled licensing; no separate connector is required.
* Keep installed features working while protecting official update downloads.

= 0.1.0 =
* Add website connection settings and native private plugin updates.
* Refresh download authorization and verify packages before installation.
